relics.name: Burning Blood
relics.text: At the end of combat, heal 6 HP.
relics.effect: Burning Blood is the Starter Relic of the Ironclad; he will always start every new run with it in his possession and it can't be obtained by any other character.

relics.name: Akabeko
relics.text: Your first Attack each combat deals 8 additional damage
relics.effect: Akabeko is a Common Relic. Its damage buff is applied as 8 stacks of Vigor at the start of combat.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: When calculating damage dealt, all the additive bonuses are added first, and then multiplicative bonuses are multiplied. The final result is rounded down. Akabeko's Vigor is an additive bonus.

relics.name: Anchor
relics.text: Start each combat with 10 Block.
relics.effect: Anchor is a Common Relic.

relics.name: Blood Vial
relics.text: At the start of each combat, heal 2 HP.
relics.effect: Blood Vial is a Common Relic.

relics.name: Girya
relics.text: You can now gain Strength at Rest Sites (up to 3 times).
relics.effect: Girya is a Rare Relic. It adds a "Lift" option to Rest Sites. After using Lift, Girya will grant the player 1 Strength at the start of every combat. Lift may be used up to 3 times total, granting up to 3 Strength, and then the Lift option will be disabled.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.; Order（wiki 原文）: When calculating damage dealt, all the additive bonuses are added first, and then multiplicative bonuses are multiplied. The final result is rounded down. Girya's Strength is an additive bonus.

relics.name: Vajra
relics.text: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Strength.
relics.effect: Vajra is a Common Relic.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: When calculating damage dealt, all the additive bonuses are added first, and then multiplicative bonuses are multiplied. The final result is rounded down. Vajra's Strength is an additive bonus.

relics.name: Lantern
relics.text: Gain 1 Energy on the first turn of each combat.
relics.effect: Lantern is a Common Relic.

relics.name: Bronze Scales
relics.text: Start each combat with 3 Thorns.
relics.effect: Bronze Scales is a Common Relic.

relics.name: Oddly Smooth Stone
relics.text: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Dexterity.
relics.effect: Oddly Smooth Stone is a Common Relic.

relics.name: Du-Vu Doll
relics.text: For each Curse in your deck, start each combat with 1 Strength.
relics.effect: Du-Vu Doll is a Rare Relic. Its description also shows the number of Curses you have in your deck.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: When calculating damage dealt, all the additive bonuses are added first, and then multiplicative bonuses are multiplied. The final result is rounded down. Du-Vu Doll's Strength is an additive bonus.

relics.name: Thread and Needle
relics.text: At the start of each combat, gain 4 Plated Armor.
relics.effect: Thread and Needle is a Rare Relic.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: • Plated Armor will trigger after Orichalcum has checked whether the player has 0 Icon Block, allowing both Thread and Needle and Orichalcum to be used together effectively.

relics.name: Mutagenic Strength
relics.text: Start each combat with 3 Strength. At the end of your first turn, lose 3 Strength.
relics.effect: Mutagenic Strength is an Event Relic. It grants 3 Strength and 3 Strength Down at the start of combat.
relics.notes:
Source: Augmenter; Order（wiki 原文）: • When calculating damage dealt, all the additive bonuses are added first, and then multiplicative bonuses are multiplied. The final result is rounded down. Mutagenic Strength's Strength is an additive bonus.
<!-- If you decide to change this section on Clockwork Souvenir in some way, please also change it in the Clockwork Souvenir page for consistency! -->
• If the player has both Clockwork Souvenir and Mutagenic Strength, the effect is dependent on the order in which the relics were obtained. The order of the effects is also somewhat counter-intuitive, and can seem "backwards" of their pickup order.
• If Clockwork Souvenir was obtained first, Mutagenic Strength applies its effects before Clockwork Souvenir. The player starts each combat with 3 Strength Down, 3 Strength, and 1 Artifact.
• If Mutagenic Strength was obtained first, the Artifact from Clockwork Souvenir is applied first and negates the Strength Down from Mutagenic Strength. The player starts each combat with 3 Strength, which will remain for the rest of the fight.

relics.name: Sling of Courage
relics.text: Start each Elite combat with 2 Strength.
relics.effect: Sling of Courage is a Shop Relic.

relics.name: Preserved Insect
relics.text: Enemies in Elite combats have 25% less HP.
relics.effect: Preserved Insect is a Common Relic. It reduces the HP of enemies in Elite encounters by 25%. The Max HP of the elite enemies are unaffected by the HP penalty; instead their current HP immediately lowers at the start of combat as if they had taken damage.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 53.

relics.name: Pantograph
relics.text: At the start of Boss combats, heal 25 HP.
relics.effect: Pantograph is an Uncommon Relic.

relics.name: Neow's Lament
relics.text: Enemies in your first 3 combats will have 1 HP.
relics.effect: Neow's Lament is an Event Relic. It sets the HP to 1 for ALL enemies in the next 3 combats. This applies to combats of any type; normal enemies, elites, and bosses (although it is quite difficult to reach a Boss with at least one charge remaining).
relics.notes: Source: Neow

relics.name: Fossilized Helix
relics.text: Prevent the first time you would lose HP in combat.
relics.effect: Fossilized Helix is a Rare Relic. It gives the player 1 Buffer at the start of each combat.

relics.name: Data Disk
relics.text: Start each combat with 1 Focus.
relics.effect: Data Disk is a Defect-exclusive Common Relic.

relics.name: Ectoplasm
relics.text: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. You can no longer gain Gold.
relics.effect: Ectoplasm is a Boss Relic.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Gold

relics.name: Sozu
relics.text: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. You can no longer obtain potions.
relics.effect: Sozu is a Boss Relic. It prevents Potions from being acquired, but any Potions the player has before acquiring Sozu can still be used as normal.

relics.name: Busted Crown
relics.text: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. Future card rewards have 2 less cards to choose from.
relics.effect: Busted Crown is a Boss Relic.

relics.name: Coffee Dripper
relics.text: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. You can no longer Rest at Rest Sites.
relics.effect: Coffee Dripper is a Boss Relic.

relics.name: Cursed Key
relics.text: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. Whenever you open a non-Boss chest, obtain a Curse.
relics.effect: Cursed Key is a Boss Relic. It grants 1 Energy at the start of each turn in combat, at the cost of adding a Curse to the player's deck any time they open a non-Boss Chest. The Curse that gets added to the player's deck will never be one of Ascender's Bane, Curse of the Bell, Necronomicurse, or Pride.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • The Curse is added to the player's deck immediately after opening the Chest.
• If the Chest contains Omamori, it can never be used to block the Curse that was received from the chest that contained this relic.
• If the player skips the Chest without opening it, they will avoid gaining a Curse.
• If the player opens the Chest but does not collect any of its contents, they will still gain the Curse.

relics.name: Fusion Hammer
relics.text: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. You can no longer Smith at Rest Sites.
relics.effect: Fusion Hammer is a Boss Relic.

relics.name: Runic Dome
relics.text: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. You can no longer see enemy intents.
relics.effect: Runic Dome is a Boss Relic.

relics.name: Velvet Choker
relics.text: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. You cannot play more than 6 cards per turn.
relics.effect: Velvet Choker is a Boss Relic.

relics.name: Philosopher's Stone
relics.text: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. ALL enemies start combat with 1 Strength.
relics.effect: Philosopher's Stone is a Boss Relic.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • The Strength buff from Philosopher's Stone is applied to enemies immediately when combat begins. They appear to have the Strength already applied to them by the time their HP and buffs are visible.
• If new enemies enter combat mid-way through (such as from Gremlin Leader or Reptomancer summoning Minions), then the new enemies will also receive the Strength buff immediately after they're summoned. They appear to enter combat with the Strength already applied to them.
• This is in contrast to Preserved Insect which only affects enemies that are present during the start of combat, and has no effect on enemies summoned mid-way through.

relics.name: Mark of Pain
relics.text: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. At the start of combat, shuffle 2 Wounds into your draw pile.
relics.effect: Mark of Pain is an Ironclad-exclusive Boss Relic. The Wounds are not added directly to the player's deck; they are added to their draw pile after drawing their 5-card opening hand at the start of combat.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • Mark of Pain adds Wounds to the player's draw pile after they have drawn their 5-card opening hand.
• Mark of Pain adds Wounds in relic pickup order ("from left to right"), so if any of the following relics were acquired after Mark of Pain then it will be possible for them to draw one or more Wounds:
• Bag of Preparation
• Snecko Eye
• Ring of the Snake and Ring of the Serpent (although it is impossible to have either of these Relics on Ironclad through normal gameplay)
• Mark of Pain will always add Wounds before Gambling Chip triggers, regardless of relic pickup order. In other words, it will always be possible for the card draw effect from Gambling Chip to draw one or more Wounds.

relics.name: Snecko Eye
relics.text: At the start of your turn, draw 2 additional cards. Start each combat Confused.
relics.effect: Snecko Eye is a Boss Relic. The player will draw 2 additional cards every turn while it is in their possession. At the start of combat, it grants the player the Confused Debuff, which randomizes the cost of any drawn card between 0 and 3 Energy (inclusive).
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: • Snecko Eye always applies Confused before Clockwork Souvenir grants Artifact, no matter the order those relics were obtained.

relics.name: Happy Flower
relics.text: Every 3 turns, gain 1 Energy.
relics.effect: Happy Flower is a Common Relic. The counter that keeps track of how many turns have passed is not reset between combats, and it's incremented at the start of the player's turn. This means that if the counter is at 2 at the end of a combat, it will trigger at the start of the next combat and reset to 0 as normal.

relics.name: Incense Burner
relics.text: Every 6 turns, gain 1 Intangible.
relics.effect: Incense Burner is a Rare Relic. The counter that keeps track of how many turns have passed is not reset between combats, and it's incremented at the start of the player's turn.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • At the start of the player's turn, the counter is incremented by 1. If it increases to 6, resets to 0 and the player gains 1 Intangible.
• The Intangible is added before the following effects trigger, effectively reducing their damage to 1:
• Damage dealt from having multiple copies of Brutality in play.
• Damage dealt from having multiple copies of Combust in play.
• Damage dealt from Mayhem playing a card that immediately damages the player (such as Bloodletting).
• Damage dealt from Mayhem playing an Attack on an enemy with Thorns or Sharp Hide.
• The 99999 damage dealt from Blasphemer the turn after playing Blasphemy.

relics.name: Ink Bottle
relics.text: Whenever you play 10 cards, draw 1 card.
relics.effect: Ink Bottle is an Uncommon Relic that draws 1 card for every 10 cards played. The counter that keeps track of how many cards have been played is not reset between combats.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: • Ink Bottle's counter increments after the played card's effect is finished resolving. For example, the card draw will be wasted if the 10th card played is Scrawl as the player's hand will already be full when Ink Bottle triggers.

relics.name: Inserter
relics.text: Every 2 turns, gain 1 Orb slot.
relics.effect: Inserter is a Defect-exclusive Boss Relic. The counter that keeps track of how many turns have passed is not reset between combats, and it's incremented at the start of the player's turn. This means that if the counter is at 1 at the end of a combat, it will trigger at the start of the next combat and reset to 0 as normal.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • Inserter's counter is incremented at the start of the player's turn.
• On turns where Inserter triggers, the Orb Slot will be gained before the player draws their opening hand.

relics.name: Nunchaku
relics.text: Every time you play 10 Attacks, gain 1 Energy.
relics.effect: Nunchaku is a Common Relic. The counter that keeps track of how many Attacks have been played is not reset between turns or combats.

relics.name: Pen Nib
relics.text: Every 10th Attack you play deals double damage.
relics.effect: Pen Nib is a Common Relic. The counter that keeps track of how many Attacks have been played is not reset between turns or combats.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: When calculating damage dealt, all the additive bonuses are added first, and then multiplicative bonuses are multiplied. The final result is rounded down. Pen Nib's Pen Nib buff is a multiplicative bonus, and stacks with Vulnerable.

relics.name: Sundial
relics.text: Every 3 times you shuffle your draw pile, gain 2 Energy.
relics.effect: Sundial is an Uncommon Relic. The counter that keeps track of how many times the draw pile has been shuffled is not reset between combats.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: • Sundial triggers its Energy gain after the card draw effect has finished resolving.

relics.name: Omamori
relics.text: Negate the next 2 Curses you obtain.
relics.effect: Omamori is a Common Relic.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.; Order（wiki 原文）: • If Omamori is acquired as a reward from Calling Bell then it can never block Curse of the Bell since Calling Bell drops the relics after Curse of the Bell is added to the player's deck

relics.name: Lizard Tail
relics.text: When you would die, heal to 50% of your Max HP instead (works once).
relics.effect: Lizard Tail is a Rare Relic.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: • Revival effects generally trigger from "top to bottom", so the potion Fairy in a Bottle will trigger before Lizard Tail.

relics.name: Mercury Hourglass
relics.text: At the start of your turn, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.
relics.effect: Mercury Hourglass is an Uncommon Relic. At the start of each turn in combat, it deals 3 damage to all enemies. This damage is not treated as Attack damage, and therefore does not benefit from effects like Strength, Vulnerable, or The Boot.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.; Order（wiki 原文）: • Mercury Hourglass triggers before the player has drawn their hand for the turn, except on the first turn of combat where it only triggers after the opening hand has been drawn.

relics.name: Red Skull
relics.text: While your HP is at or below 50%, you have 3 additional Strength.
relics.effect: Red Skull is an Ironclad-exclusive Common Relic. As with most rounding operations, the 50% is rounded down to the nearest whole number to determine when the player gains Strength during combat. For example, if the player has 75 Max HP, Red Skull will trigger when the player has 37 current HP.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • When calculating damage dealt, all the additive bonuses are added first, and then multiplicative bonuses are multiplied. The final result is rounded down. Red Skull's Strength is an additive bonus.
• The Strength is gained immediately after the player's current HP changes, even when it's not their turn.

relics.name: Toolbox
relics.text: At the start of each combat, choose 1 of 3 random Colorless cards and add the chosen card into your hand.
relics.effect: Toolbox is a Shop Relic.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • Toolbox will always trigger before the player draws any cards for their opening hand. This includes the normal 5 cards drawn per turn, and card draw effects such as Ring of the Snake and Bag of Preparation.
• Toolbox will trigger with other "before opening hand" relics (such as Ninja Scroll) in pickup order (i.e. from left to right in the player's relic bar).

relics.name: Bag of Marbles
relics.text: At the start of each combat, apply 1 Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
relics.effect: Bag of Marbles is a Common Relic.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • When calculating damage dealt, all the additive bonuses are added first, and then multiplicative bonuses are multiplied. The final result is rounded down. Bag of Marbles' Vulnerable is a multiplicative bonus, and stacks with Strength and Vigor.
• Bag of Marbles will trigger with other "after opening hand" relics (such as Red Mask and Twisted Funnel) in pickup order (i.e. from left to right in the player's relic bar).

relics.name: Bag of Preparation
relics.text: At the start of each combat, draw 2 additional cards.
relics.effect: Bag of Preparation is a Common Relic.

relics.name: Clockwork Souvenir
relics.text: Start each combat with 1 Artifact.
relics.effect: Clockwork Souvenir is a Shop Relic. For more information on which effects can be prevented by Clockwork Souvenir's Artifact (and their sources), see Debuffs.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: <!-- If you decide to change this section on Mutagenic Strength in some way, please also change it in the Mutagenic Strength page for consistency! -->
• If the player has both Clockwork Souvenir and Mutagenic Strength, the effect is dependent on the order in which the relics were obtained. The order of the effects is also somewhat counter-intuitive, and can seem "backwards" of their pickup order.
• If Clockwork Souvenir was obtained first, Mutagenic Strength applies its effects before Clockwork Souvenir. The player starts each combat with 3 Strength Down, 3 Strength, and 1 Artifact.
• If Mutagenic Strength was obtained first, the Artifact from Clockwork Souvenir is applied first and negates the Strength Down from Mutagenic Strength. The player starts each combat with 3 Strength, which will remain for the rest of the fight.
• Clockwork Souvenir's Artifact will always be applied before the Weak from Gremlin Visage, regardless of the order in which the two relics were obtained, negating it if no other Debuffs are applied in between.
• If the player has all three of Clockwork Souvenir, Mutagenic Strength, and Gremlin Visage, then the Weak will only be prevented if Mutagenic Strength was acquired after Clockwork Souvenir. It does not matter when Gremlin Visage was acquired relative to the other relics. Here is an explanation of the ordering and the state of the player's Debuffs depending on the relic pickup order:
• The player will be left with 3 Strength and 1 Weak (no Strength Down) if Mutagenic Strength was acquired before Clockwork Souvenir.
• The player will be left with 3 Strength Down and 3 Strength (no Weak) if Mutagenic Strength was acquired after Clockwork Souvenir.
• Clockwork Souvenir's Artifact will always be applied after the Confused from Snecko Eye, regardless of the order in which the two relics were obtained, and can therefore never negate it.

relics.name: Gremlin Visage
relics.text: Start each combat with 1 Weak.
relics.effect: Gremlin Visage is an Event Relic.
relics.notes: Source: Face Trader; Order（wiki 原文）: • Clockwork Souvenir's Artifact will prevent Gremlin Visage's Weak regardless of which order they were acquired in.

relics.name: Red Mask
relics.text: At the start of each combat, apply 1 Weak to ALL enemies.
relics.effect: Red Mask is an Event Relic.
relics.notes:
Source: Masked Bandits, Tomb of Lord Red Mas; Order（wiki 原文）: • When calculating damage dealt, all the additive bonuses are added first, and then multiplicative bonuses are multiplied. The final result is rounded down. Red Mask's Weak is a multiplicative bonus.
• Red Mask will trigger with other "after opening hand" relics (such as Bag of Marbles and Twisted Funnel) in pickup order (i.e. from left to right in the player's relic bar).

relics.name: Twisted Funnel
relics.text: At the start of each combat, apply 4 Poison to ALL enemies.
relics.effect: Twisted Funnel is a Silent-exclusive Shop Relic.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • Despite "flashing" immediately upon entering combat, Twisted Funnel will only apply Poison after the player has finished drawing their opening hand.
• Twisted Funnel will even wait to trigger until after additional turn 1 card draw, such as Ring of the Snake and Bag of Preparation.
• Twisted Funnel will trigger with other "after opening hand" relics (such as Red Mask and Bag of Marbles) in pickup order (i.e. from left to right in the player's relic bar).

relics.name: Art of War
relics.text: If you do not play any Attacks during your turn, gain an additional Energy next turn.
relics.effect: Art of War is a Common Relic.

relics.name: Horn Cleat
relics.text: At the start of your 2nd turn, gain 14 Block.
relics.effect: Horn Cleat is an Uncommon Relic.

relics.name: Damaru
relics.text: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Mantra.
relics.effect: Damaru is a Watcher-exclusive Common Relic.

relics.name: Captain's Wheel
relics.text: At the start of your 3rd turn, gain 18 Block.
relics.effect: Captain's Wheel is a Rare Relic.

relics.name: Emotion Chip
relics.text: If you lost HP during the previous turn, trigger the passive ability of all Orbs at the start of your turn.
relics.effect: Emotion Chip is a Defect-exclusive Rare Relic.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Orb; Order（wiki 原文）: • Emotion Chip will trigger the passive ability of all Orbs before Biased Cognition's Bias reduces the player's Focus, despite the visually appearing otherwise.

relics.name: Pocketwatch
relics.text: Whenever you play 3 or less cards during your turn, draw 3 additional cards at the start of your next turn.
relics.effect: Pocketwatch is a Rare Relic.

relics.name: Ice Cream
relics.text: Energy is now conserved between turns.
relics.effect: Ice Cream is a Rare Relic. It prevents the player's Energy from being reset at the start of each turn, and instead adds the maximum energy limit (typically 3, but can increase from certain relics) to the player's current energy at the start of each turn.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Energy

relics.name: Warped Tongs
relics.text: At the start of your turn, Upgrade a random card in your hand for the rest of combat.
relics.effect: Warped Tongs is an Event Relic.
relics.notes:
Source: Ominous Forge; Order（wiki 原文）: • Warped Tongs always waits to trigger until after the player has finished drawing their opening hand.
<!-- Warped Tongs has the same ordering/timing as Gambling Chip, so if you change this section please also check if the change makes sense to be made for Gambling Chip as well! -->
• Warped Tongs will always trigger after the following effects have triggered regardless of whether Warped Tongs was acquired before or after them:
• Ring of the Snake and Ring of the Serpent
• Bag of Preparation
• Snecko Eye
• Pure Water and Holy Water (the Miracle(s) are added to the player's hand first, and may be Upgraded)
• Bottled Flame, Bottled Lightning, and Bottled Tornado (the bottled card may be Upgraded)
• Ninja Scroll (the Shivs are added to the player's hand first, and one of them may be Upgraded)
• Mark of Pain (the Wounds are shuffled into the player's draw pile first)
• Enchiridion (the free Power that was added to the player's hand may be Upgraded)
• Toolbox (the player will be prompted to choose 1 of 3 Colorless cards first, and it may be Upgraded)
• Warped Tongs will trigger before or after Gambling Chip depending on their pickup order (i.e. from left to right in the player's relic bar).

relics.name: Kunai
relics.text: Every time you play 3 Attacks in a single turn, gain 1 Dexterity
relics.effect: Kunai is an Uncommon Relic.

relics.name: Ornamental Fan
relics.text: Every time you play 3 Attacks in a single turn, gain 4 Block.
relics.effect: Ornamental Fan is an Uncommon Relic. Ornamental Fan can be triggered multiple times in the same turn, granting its Block on the 3rd, 6th, 9th, etc. Attack played during the same turn.

relics.name: Shuriken
relics.text: Every time you play 3 Attacks in a single turn, gain 1 Strength.
relics.effect: Shuriken is an Uncommon Relic.

relics.name: Necronomicon
relics.text: The first Attack played each turn that costs 2 or more is played twice. Upon pickup, obtain a special Curse.
relics.effect: Necronomicon is an Event Relic. The "special Curse" that it adds to the player's deck is Necronomicurse.
relics.notes: Source: Cursed Tome

relics.name: Duality
relics.text: Whenever you play an Attack, gain 1 temporary Dexterity.
relics.effect: Duality is a Watcher-exclusive Uncommon Relic. After an Attack has been played and finishes resolving its effect, Duality will apply 1 Dexterity and 1 Dexterity Down to the player.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • When playing an Attack that also grants Block (such as Iron Wave), the Block will be granted before the Dexterity is applied. Duality will, somewhat deceptively, flash to indicate it has been triggered before the card is played however.
• Dexterity Down, much like Strength Down, behaves somewhat unintuitively with Artifact.
• If the Artifact is applied before an Attack triggers adding the Dexterity and Dexterity Down, then the Artifact is consumed by blocking the Dexterity Down and the player is left with 1 normal Dexterity that lasts for the remainder of the fight.
• If one or more Attacks trigger adding the Dexterity Down and then Artifact is applied afterwards, the Artifact is consumed at the end of the current turn when the Dexterity Down would trigger and prevents it from reducing the player's Dexterity. The Dexterity Down is still removed from the player as normal when this happens. The player is left with however much Dexterity they've accumulated so far, which now lasts for the remainder of the fight.
• If the player already has some Dexterity Down, then gains Artifact, and then plays another Attack to trigger adding the Dexterity and Dexterity Down, then the Artifact will be consumed immediately and only block the 1 new Dexterity Down. The rest of the Dexterity Down that was applied before the Artifact will still trigger at the end of the turn as normal. The player is left with 1 normal Dexterity that lasts for the remainder of the fight.

relics.name: Letter Opener
relics.text: Every time you play 3 Skills in a single turn, deal 5 damage to ALL enemies.
relics.effect: Letter Opener is an Uncommon Relic. Whenever 3 Skills are played in the same turn, 5 damage is dealt to all enemies. This damage is not treated as Attack damage, and therefore does not benefit from effects like Strength, Vulnerable, or The Boot. Letter Opener can be triggered multiple times in the same turn, dealing its damage on the 3rd, 6th, 9th, etc. skill played during the same turn.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • The effect(s) of the Skill that triggers Letter Opener will (usually* ) finish resolving before Letter Opener triggers its damage. This is somewhat deceptive, as Letter Opener will "flash" immediately when the skill is played.
• E.g. If playing Defend would trigger Letter Opener, the Block is gained before Letter Opener's damage triggers.
• * In the case of cards like Havoc that play another card as its effect, Letter Opener will trigger after Havoc is discarded but before the card drawn by Havoc is played.

relics.name: Bird-Faced Urn
relics.text: Whenever you play a Power card, heal 2 HP.
relics.effect: Bird-Faced Urn is a Rare Relic.

relics.name: Mummified Hand
relics.text: Whenever you play a Power card, a random card in your hand costs 0 that turn.
relics.effect: Mummified Hand is an Uncommon Relic. The description is somewhat misleading, as the Energy-reduction effect will be lost once played. Even if it's the same turn, if the affected card is played and then returned to the hand by any means (e.g. using Hologram), the card will be at its original cost.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: • Mummified Hand will trigger immediately after a Power is played, and before cards that interact with Powers being played (such as Heatsinks and Storm).

relics.name: Strike Dummy
relics.text: Cards containing "Strike" deal 3 additional damage.
relics.effect: Strike Dummy is an Uncommon Relic. Any card that contains the word "Strike" in its name deals an additional 3 damage. See #Interactions for a list of cards this applies to.

relics.name: Wrist Blade
relics.text: Attacks that cost 0 deal 4 additional damage.
relics.effect: Wrist Blade is a Silent-exclusive Boss Relic. Attacks that cost 0 [E]Energy will deal an additional 4 damage when played. This increase is reflected in the card text during combat.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: When calculating damage dealt, all the additive bonuses are added first, and then multiplicative bonuses are multiplied. The final result is rounded down. Wrist Blade's damage increase is an additive bonus, behaving similarly to Strength that only affects specific cards.

relics.name: Paper Phrog
relics.text: Enemies with Vulnerable take 75% more damage rather than 50%.
relics.effect: Paper Phrog is an Ironclad-exclusive Uncommon Relic. It further increases the damage bonus from Vulnerable from 50% to 75%; multiplying the damage from each Attack by 1.75. As usual, the final total damage is always rounded down.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Vulnerable

relics.name: Cloak Clasp
relics.text: At the end of your turn, gain 1 Block for each card in your hand.
relics.effect: Cloak Clasp is a Watcher-exclusive Rare Relic.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • Cloak Clasp will trigger after Orichalcum has checked whether the player has 0 Block, allowing both relics to be used together effectively.
• Cloak Clasp will trigger before cards in hand trigger effects that cause them to leave the hand before the normal discard timing (such as cards with Ethereal, or cards which damage the player at the end of the turn such as Burn or Regret).

relics.name: Nilry's Codex
relics.text: At the end of each turn, you may shuffle 1 of 3 random cards to shuffle into your draw pile.
relics.effect: Nilry's Codex is an Event Relic. After the player ends their turn, they are presented with 3 cards (similar to a normal card reward). They may either choose one of them to add to their draw pile, or skip adding any of the offered cards. As with all card generation effects in combat, any card(s) generated by Nilry's Codex do not persist between combats as they are added to the player's draw pile and not their deck.
relics.notes:
Source: Cursed Tome; Order（wiki 原文）: • Nilry's Codex will present the player with 3 cards at the end of their turn before their hand is discarded.
• Nilry's Codex adds the card to the player's deck before end-of-turn effects like Combust.
• This means that, due to the interaction between Centennial Puzzle and Combust, it is possible for the player to draw the card created by Nilry's Codex and immediately discard it.

relics.name: Orichalcum
relics.text: If you end your turn without Block, gain 6 Block.
relics.effect: Orichalcum is a Common Relic.
relics.notes:
InteractsWith: Block; Order（wiki 原文）: The following effects will trigger after Orichalcum has already checked if the player has no Block (i.e. they can be used effectively alongside Orichalcum without preventing its Block gain):
• Metallicize
• Plated Armor
• Frost Orbs
• Cloak Clasp
• Ethereal cards that Exhaust at the end of the turn and grant Block due to Feel No Pain

relics.name: Stone Calendar
relics.text: At the end of turn 7, deal 52 damage to ALL enemies.
relics.effect: Stone Calendar is a Rare Relic. At the end of turn 7, it deals 52 damage to all enemies. The damage is not repeated for turns that are multiples of 7, it is only at the end of specifically turn 7. This damage is not treated as Attack damage, and therefore does not benefit from effects like Strength or Vulnerable.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: • Stone Calendar triggers before Combust, so no HP will be lost if the relic's damage ends the fight.

relics.name: Runic Pyramid
relics.text: At the end of your turn, you no longer discard your hand.
relics.effect: Runic Pyramid is a Boss Relic.

relics.name: Tungsten Rod
relics.text: Whenever you would lose HP, lose 1 less.
relics.effect: Tungsten Rod is a Rare Relic. Tungsten Rod will reduce ALL HP loss by 1, even from self-damaging cards (such as Bloodletting or Combust) or HP-loss effects in Events (such as Scrap Ooze or Cursed Tome).
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • Torii triggers before Tungsten Rod.
• When 1 unblocked damage is received with Tungsten Rod, various effects behave differently:
• A stack of Buffer will be used up.
• Static Discharge will trigger.
• Rupture will not trigger.
• Plated Armor will not lose a stack.
• Relics that trigger upon taking damage will have no effect. This includes:
• * Runic Cube
• * Centennial Puzzle
• * Emotion Chip
• * Self-Forming Clay

relics.name: Torii
relics.text: Whenever you would receive 5 or less unblocked Attack damage, reduce it to 1.
relics.effect: Torii is a Rare Relic.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: • Torii triggers before Tungsten Rod.

relics.name: Centennial Puzzle
relics.text: The first time you lose HP each combat, draw 3 cards.
relics.effect: Centennial Puzzle is a Common Relic.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Lose HP

relics.name: Self-Forming Clay
relics.text: Whenever you lose HP, gain 3 Block next turn.
relics.effect: Self-Forming Clay is an Ironclad-exclusive Uncommon Relic. Whenever the player loses HP in combat, 3 stacks of the Next Turn Block buff will be applied. Next turn, the player will gain Block equal to the amount of stacks they have and the buff will be removed.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • Next Turn Block is applied as soon as the player loses HP even if it is not their turn.
• Next Turn Block is converted to Block at the start of the player's turn.

relics.name: Magic Flower
relics.text: Healing is 50% more effective during combat.
relics.effect: Magic Flower is an Ironclad-exclusive Rare Relic. All healing received during combat is multiplied by x1.5, rounded to the nearest whole number (and rounding up on results ending in .5)https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rounding#Rounding_half_up.

relics.name: Runic Cube
relics.text: Whenever you lose HP, draw 1 card.
relics.effect: Runic Cube is an Ironclad-exclusive Boss Relic. Whenever the player loses any amount of HP for any reason during combat, they will draw one card.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Lose HP; Order（wiki 原文）: • Runic Cube triggers immediately after the player has lost HP. For example, Runic Cube will draw 1 card from Offering's damage before Offering's own card draw takes effect.

relics.name: Meat on the Bone
relics.text: If your HP is at or below 50% at the end of combat, heal 12 HP.
relics.effect: Meat on the Bone is an Uncommon Relic.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.

relics.name: The Abacus
relics.text: Whenever you shuffle your draw pile, gain 6 Block.
relics.effect: The Abacus is a Shop Relic.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: • The Abacus will trigger after the player has finished drawing cards post-shuffle.

relics.name: Charon's Ashes
relics.text: Whenever you Exhaust a card, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.
relics.effect: Charon's Ashes is a Rare Ironclad Relic.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Exhaust

relics.name: Dead Branch
relics.text: Whenever you Exhaust a card, add a random card to your hand.
relics.effect: Dead Branch is a Rare Relic.
relics.notes:
InteractsWith: Exhaust; Order（wiki 原文）: • The Exhausted card will be removed from the player's hand before Dead Branch triggers.
• For example, playing a card such as Disarm with 10 cards in hand will remove the Disarm first, bringing the player to only 9 cards in hand, then Dead Branch will add a random card to the player's hand.
• The effects of a card which Exhausts itself or another card will fully resolve before Dead Branch triggers.
• For example, if playing Burning Pact will draw enough cards to fill the player's hand with 10 cards, then the card generated by Dead Branch will overflow into the player's discard pile since their hand is full.

relics.name: Strange Spoon

relics.effect: Strange Spoon is a Shop Relic.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Exhaust

relics.name: Gremlin Horn
relics.text: Whenever an enemy dies, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.
relics.effect: Gremlin Horn is an Uncommon Relic.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: • If an enemy dies on their turn (e.g. by Poison or attacking into Thorns), Gremlin Horn will still trigger its extra Energy and card draw. However, without Ice Cream, energy is reset to its current maximum at the start of the player's turn so the extra energy will be effectively lost.

relics.name: The Specimen
relics.text: Whenever an enemy dies, transfer any Poison it has to a random enemy.
relics.effect: The Specimen is a Silent-exclusive Rare Relic.

relics.name: Hand Drill
relics.text: Whenever you break an enemy's Block, apply 2 Vulnerable.
relics.effect: Hand Drill is a Shop Relic.
relics.notes:
InteractsWith: Block; Order（wiki 原文）: • When calculating damage dealt, all the additive bonuses are added first, and then multiplicative bonuses are multiplied. The final result is rounded down. Hand Drill's Vulnerable is a multiplicative bonus.
• If an enemy's Block is broken from a multi-hit attack (such as Pummel or Riddle with Holes), Hand Drill will trigger adding Vulnerable after the attack has completely finished all of its hits.

relics.name: The Boot
relics.text: Whenever you would deal 4 or less unblocked Attack damage, increase it to 5.
relics.effect: The Boot is a Common Relic.

relics.name: Unceasing Top
relics.text: Whenever you have no cards in hand during your turn, draw a card.
relics.effect: Unceasing Top is a Rare Relic.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: Unceasing Top will trigger whenever the player's hand has no cards in it after any ongoing effects have resolved. In other words, Unceasing Top will check if it should trigger right before control is handed back to the player to play their next card. This can be unintuitive at first, but some sense can be made with a few examples:

relics.name: Calipers
relics.text: At the start of your turn, lose 15 Block rather than all of your Block.
relics.effect: Calipers is a Rare Relic.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Block

relics.name: Enchiridion
relics.text: At the start of each combat, add a random Power card into your hand. It costs 0 for that turn.
relics.effect: Enchiridion is an Event Relic.
relics.notes:
Source: Cursed Tome; Order（wiki 原文）: • Enchiridion will always trigger before the player draws any cards for their opening hand. This includes the normal 5 cards drawn per turn, and card draw effects such as Ring of the Snake and Bag of Preparation.
• Enchiridion will trigger with other "before opening hand" relics (such as Ninja Scroll and Toolbox) in pickup order (i.e. from left to right in the player's relic bar).

relics.name: Tingsha
relics.text: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
relics.effect: Tingsha is a Silent-exclusive Rare Relic. This damage is not treated as Attack damage, and therefore does not benefit from effects like Strength or Vulnerable.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Discard

relics.name: Tough Bandages
relics.text: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, gain 3 Block.
relics.effect: Tough Bandages is a Silent-exclusive Rare Relic.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Discard

relics.name: Melange
relics.text: Whenever you shuffle your draw pile, Scry 3.
relics.effect: Melange is a Watcher-exclusive Shop Relic.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • Melange triggers after the player has finished drawing the cards that caused their draw pile to be shuffled.
• As an example, imagine the player has 2 cards in their draw pile and then ends their turn. At the start of their next turn, they will draw 2 cards, then shuffle their draw pile, then draw their remaining 3 cards (to complete their 5-card opening hand), and then Melange will trigger its Scry on whatever is left of their new draw pile.

relics.name: Ring of the Snake
relics.text: At the start of each combat, draw 2 additional cards.
relics.effect: Ring of the Snake is the Starter Relic of the Silent; they will always start every new run with it in their possession and it can't be obtained by any other character.

relics.name: Ring of the Serpent
relics.text: Replaces Ring of the Snake. At the start of your turn, draw 1 additional card.
relics.effect: Ring of the Serpent is a Silent-exclusive Boss Relic. It's the upgraded form of Ring of the Snake, and replaces it entirely when acquired from a Boss Chest.

relics.name: Ninja Scroll
relics.text: At the start each combat, add 3 Shivs into your hand.
relics.effect: Ninja Scroll is a Silent-exclusive Uncommon Relic that adds three Shivs to the player's hand immediately at the start of each combat.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • Ninja Scroll will always trigger before the player draws any cards for their opening hand. This includes the normal 5 cards drawn per turn, and card draw effects such as Ring of the Snake and Bag of Preparation.
• Ninja Scroll will trigger with other "before opening hand" relics (such as Toolbox) in pickup order (i.e. from left to right in the player's relic bar).

relics.name: Hovering Kite
relics.text: The first time you discard a card each turn, gain 1 Energy.
relics.effect: Hovering Kite is a Silent-exclusive Boss Relic.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Discard

relics.name: Violet Lotus
relics.text: Whenever you exit Calm, gain an additional Energy.
relics.effect: Violet Lotus is a Watcher-exclusive Boss Relic. It increases the amount of [E] Energy gained when exiting the Calm Stance by one, from 2 to 3.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Calm

relics.name: Cracked Core
relics.text: At the start of each combat, Channel 1 Lightning.
relics.effect: Cracked Core is the Starter Relic of the Defect; they will always start every new run with it in their possession and it can't be obtained by any other character.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • Cracked Core, Symbiotic Virus, and Nuclear Battery all Channel an Orb at the start of combat. The order of these Orbs is determined by the order the Relics were acquired in. Since Cracked Core is always the first Relic acquired (assuming you still have it), the Lightning Orb will always be Channelled first.
• As there are only three Relics that Channel Orbs at the start of combat, and Defect always starts with at least three Orb Slots, the Orbs can never be Evoked before your first turn starts.

relics.name: Pure Water
relics.text: At the start of each combat, add 1 Miracle into your hand.
relics.effect: Pure Water is the Starter Relic of the Watcher; they will always start every new run with it in their possession and it can't be obtained by any other character.

relics.name: Holy Water
relics.text: Replaces Pure Water. At the start of each combat, add 3 Miracles into your hand.
relics.effect: Holy Water is a Watcher-exclusive Boss Relic. It's the upgraded form of Pure Water, and replaces it entirely when acquired from a Boss Chest.

relics.name: Gold-Plated Cables
relics.text: Your rightmost Orb triggers its passive an additional time.
relics.effect: Gold-Plated Cables is a Defect-exclusive Uncommon Relic that makes it so that when your rightmost Orb triggers its Passive, it triggers an additional time.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Orb; Order（wiki 原文）: Gold-Plated Cables' extra trigger goes after the passive effect of every Orb slot at the end of the turn (or start of the turn with Emotion Chip).

relics.name: Symbiotic Virus
relics.text: At the start of each combat, Channel 1 Dark.
relics.effect: Symbiotic Virus is a Defect-exclusive Uncommon Relic.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • Symbiotic Virus, Cracked Core, and Nuclear Battery all Channel an Orb at the start of combat. The order of these Orbs is determined by the order the relics were acquired in. Since Cracked Core is always the first relic acquired (assuming you still have it), the Lightning Orb will always be Channeled first.
• As there are only three relics that Channel Orbs at the start of combat, and Defect always starts with at least three Orb slots, the Orbs can never be Evoked before your first turn starts.

relics.name: Teardrop Locket
relics.text: Start each combat in Calm.
relics.effect: Teardrop Locket is a Watcher-exclusive Uncommon Relic.

relics.name: Nuclear Battery
relics.text: At the start of each combat, Channel 1 Plasma.
relics.effect: Nuclear Battery is a Defect-exclusive Boss Relic.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • Nuclear Battery, Cracked Core, and Symbiotic Virus all Channel an Orb at the start of combat. The order of these Orbs is determined by the order the Relics were acquired in ("pickup order"). Since Cracked Core is always the first Relic acquired (assuming the player still has it), the Lightning Orb will always be Channeled first.
• As there are only three Relics that Channel Orbs at the start of combat, and Defect always starts with at least three Orb Slots, the Orbs can never be Evoked before the player's first turn starts.

relics.name: Slaver's Collar
relics.text: During Boss and Elite combats, gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn.
relics.effect: Slaver's Collar is a Boss Relic.

relics.name: Runic Capacitor
relics.text: Start each combat with 3 additional Orb Slots.
relics.effect: Runic Capacitor is a Defect-exclusive Shop Relic. The Defect will start combat with 6 Orb Slots instead of the normal 3. The maximum number of Orb Slots is 10.

relics.name: Orange Pellets
relics.text: Whenever you play a Power, Attack, and Skill in the same turn, remove all of your debuffs.
relics.effect: Orange Pellets is a Shop Relic. For a full list of the effects that Orange Pellets can remove from the player, see Debuffs.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • The Power, Attack, and Skill can be played in any order. The player does not need to follow the exact order in Orange Pellets' description.
• Orange Pellets will trigger and remove Debuffs after the final card needed to trigger it has fully resolved.
• For example, if any Attack and any Skill is played, and then a Power that applies a Debuff to the player (such as Berserk, Wraith Form, or Biased Cognition) is played to trigger Orange Pellets, then the Debuff will be removed (i.e. it will immediately remove the Vulnerable for Berserk, remove the Wraith Form for Wraith Form, and remove the Bias for Biased Cognition).

relics.notes: InteractsWith: Weak

relics.effect: Odd Mushroom is an Event Relic.

relics.notes: InteractsWith: Weak; Order（wiki 原文）: • Ginger will trigger before Artifact whenever Weak would be applied. Or in other words, no Artifact will be consumed if the player would receive Weak while possessing Ginger.

relics.name: Turnip
relics.text: You can no longer become Frail.
relics.effect: Turnip is a Rare Relic.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Frail; Order（wiki 原文）: • Turnip will trigger before Artifact whenever Frail would be applied. Or in other words, no Artifact will be consumed if the player would receive Frail while possessing Turnip.

relics.name: Ancient Tea Set
relics.text: Whenever you enter a Rest Site, start the next combat with 2 extra Energy.
relics.effect: Ancient Tea Set is a Common Relic.

relics.text: Upon pickup, Transform 3 cards, then Upgrade them.

relics.text: Whenever you gain Gold, heal 5 HP.

relics.name: Bottled Lightning

relics.name: Cauldron

relics.name: Ceramic Fish

relics.name: Chemical X

relics.text: You feel more talkative.

relics.name: Face of Cleric
relics.text: At the end of combat, raise your Max HP by 1.
relics.effect: Face of Cleric is an Event Relic.
relics.notes: Source: Face Trader

relics.name: Frozen Core
relics.text: Replaces Cracked Core. If you end your turn with any empty Orb slots, Channel 1 Frost.
relics.effect: Frozen Core is a Defect-exclusive Boss Relic. It's the upgraded form of Cracked Core, and replaces it entirely when acquired from a Boss Chest.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Orb; Order（wiki 原文）: • Frozen Core will Channel the Frost Orb before Orb Passives go off for the turn, so you will receive Block from the new Orb.

relics.name: Frozen Egg
relics.text: Whenever you add a Power card to your deck, Upgrade it.
relics.effect: Frozen Egg is an Uncommon Relic.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.

relics.name: Frozen Eye
relics.text: When viewing your Draw Pile, the cards are now shown in order.
relics.effect: Frozen Eye is a Shop Relic.

relics.name: Gambling Chip
relics.text: At the start of each combat, discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards.
relics.effect: Gambling Chip is a Rare Relic. After "start of combat" relics have triggered and the player has drawn their opening hand, they will be prompted to select any amount of cards in their hand to discard. One new card will be drawn for each card discarded in this way. The player can decide to skip discarding any cards and keep their opening hand exactly the way it is, if they prefer. After this has finished, the player's first turn continues as normal.
relics.notes:
Order（wiki 原文）: • Gambling Chip always waits to trigger until after the player has finished drawing their opening hand.
<!-- Gambling Chip has the same ordering/timing as Warped Tongs, so if you change this section please also check if the change makes sense to be made for Warped Tongs as well! -->
• Gambling Chip will always trigger after the following effects have triggered regardless of whether Gambling Chip was acquired before or after them:
• Ring of the Snake and Ring of the Serpent
• Bag of Preparation
• Snecko Eye
• Pure Water and Holy Water (the Miracle(s) are added to the player's hand first, and they can decide to discard any of them)
• Bottled Flame, Bottled Lightning, and Bottled Tornado (the player can decide to discard the bottled card)
• Ninja Scroll (the Shivs are added to the player's hand first, and they can decide to discard any of them)
• Mark of Pain (the Wounds are shuffled into the player's draw pile first, and they may be drawn if any cards are discarded and re-drawn)
• Enchiridion (the player can decide to discard the free Power that was added to their hand)
• Toolbox (the player will be prompted to choose 1 of 3 Colorless cards first, and can then decide to discard it)
• Warped Tongs will trigger before or after Gambling Chip depending on their pickup order (i.e. from left to right in the player's relic bar).

relics.name: Golden Eye
relics.text: Whenever you Scry, Scry 2 additional cards.
relics.effect: Golden Eye is a Watcher-exclusive Rare Relic. The 2 additional Scry will be combined with the original Scry of the triggering effect. Essentially, every instance of "Scry X" will behave as if it is "Scry X+2" instead.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Scry

relics.name: Golden Idol
relics.text: Enemies drop 25% more Gold.
relics.effect: Golden Idol is an Event Relic.
relics.notes: Source: Golden Idol

relics.name: Juzu Bracelet
relics.text: Regular enemy combats are no longer encountered in ? rooms.
relics.effect: Juzu Bracelet is a Common Relic. See also Unknown Location.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.

relics.name: Lee's Waffle
relics.text: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 7 and heal all of your HP.
relics.effect: Lee's Waffle is a Shop Relic.

relics.name: Mango
relics.text: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 14.
relics.effect: Mango is a Rare Relic.

relics.name: Mark of the Bloom
relics.text: You can no longer heal.
relics.effect: Mark of the Bloom is an Event Relic.
relics.notes: Source: Mind Bloom

relics.name: Matryoshka
relics.text: The next 2 non-boss chests you open contain 2 Relics.
relics.effect: Matryoshka is an Uncommon Relic. Each extra relic has a 25% chance of being Uncommon and 75% chance of being Common. Only the bottom-most relic in a Chest may be linked to the Sapphire Key.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 41.

relics.name: Maw Bank
relics.text: Whenever you climb a floor, gain 12 Gold. No longer works when you spend any Gold at a shop.
relics.effect: Maw Bank is a Common Relic.
relics.notes:
Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.
Cannot be offered by the Merchant.; Order（wiki 原文）: • Maw Bank will trigger as soon as a map node is selected.

relics.name: Meal Ticket
relics.text: Whenever you enter a shop, heal 15 HP.
relics.effect: Meal Ticket is a Common Relic. The player does not need to open the shop's inventory to trigger the healing effect since it happens automatically upon entering the Shop floor. The effect triggers regardless of whether the floor was explicitly marked as a shop or occurs randomly from an Unknown floor.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.

relics.name: Medical Kit
relics.text: Unplayable Status cards can now be played. Whenever you play a Status card, Exhaust it.
relics.effect: Medical Kit is a Shop Relic. Status cards can now be played and do not cost any Energy.
relics.notes: InteractsWith: Unplayable

relics.name: Membership Card
relics.text: 50% discount on all products!
relics.effect: Membership Card is a Shop Relic. It reduces the price of all items in the Shop by 50%, rounded to the nearest whole number (and rounding up on results ending in .5)https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rounding#Rounding_half_up.

relics.name: Molten Egg
relics.text: Whenever you add an Attack card to your deck, Upgrade it.
relics.effect: Molten Egg is an Uncommon Relic.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.

relics.name: N'loth's Gift
relics.text: Triples the chance of finding Rare cards from combat rewards.
relics.effect: N'loth's Gift is an Event Relic. It multiplies the base chance for a card to be rare by 3, before subtracting the 5% offset penalty. For more information, see Effects on Rare Card Chance.
relics.notes: Source: N'loth

relics.name: N'loth's Hungry Face
relics.text: The next non-Boss chest you open is empty.
relics.effect: N'loth's Hungry Face is an Event Relic. The next non-Boss Chest that the player opens will contain no Gold and no Relic.
relics.notes: Source: N'loth

relics.name: Old Coin
relics.text: Upon pickup, gain 300 Gold.
relics.effect: Old Coin is a Rare Relic. Its only function is to give 300 Gold immediately on pickup.
relics.notes:
Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.
Cannot be offered by the Merchant.

relics.name: Orrery
relics.text: Upon pickup, choose and add 5 cards to your deck.
relics.effect: Orrery is a Shop Relic. It presents the player with 5 normal card rewards on pickup.

relics.name: Pandora's Box
relics.text: Upon pickup, Transform all Strike and Defend cards.
relics.effect: Pandora's Box is a Boss Relic.

relics.name: Peace Pipe
relics.text: You can now remove cards from your deck at Rest Sites.
relics.effect: Peace Pipe is a Rare Relic. It adds a "Toke" option to Rest Sites, which allows the player to remove one card from their deck.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.

relics.name: Pear
relics.text: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 10.
relics.effect: Pear is an Uncommon Relic.

relics.name: Potion Belt
relics.text: Upon pickup, gain 2 Potion slots.
relics.effect: Potion Belt is a Common Relic. Immediately on pick up, the player will gain 2 potion slots, resulting in a total of 5 (4 (Ascension 11+)) slots instead of the usual 3 (2 (Ascension 11+)).
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.

relics.name: Prayer Wheel
relics.text: Normal enemies drop an additional card reward.
relics.effect: Prayer Wheel is a Rare Relic. It makes normal enemies offer an additional card reward in the end of combat rewards. This effect does not apply to Elite combat rewards or the guaranteed rare card reward after defeating a Boss. The extra card reward is otherwise functionally identical to a "normal" card reward.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.

relics.name: Prismatic Shard
relics.text: Combat reward screens now contain Colorless cards and cards from other colors.
relics.effect: Prismatic Shard is a Shop Relic. It allows all card rewards to contain Colorless cards, as well as colored cards from other characters. Cards from the player character's normal color can still be presented in card rewards, although it is now much less likely as the card pool is heavily diluted.
relics.notes: Order（wiki 原文）: • If the player is not playing as the Defect, they will gain 1 Orb Slot at the start of each combat.

relics.name: Question Card
relics.text: Future card rewards have 1 additional card to choose from.
relics.effect: Question Card is an Uncommon Relic.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.

relics.name: Red Circlet
relics.text: You ran out of relics. Impressive!
relics.effect: Red Circlet is a Special Relic that is supposed to be dropped when the Boss Relic pool is exhausted but is unobtainable in the game due to a logic bug in the code. The only way to obtain this is through modding.

relics.name: Regal Pillow
relics.text: Whenever you Rest, heal an additional 15 HP.
relics.effect: Regal Pillow is a Common Relic.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.

relics.name: Sacred Bark
relics.text: Double the effectiveness of potions.
relics.effect: Sacred Bark is a Boss Relic that doubles the effects of most Potions.

relics.name: Shovel
relics.text: You can now Dig for relics at Rest Sites.
relics.effect: Shovel is a Rare Relic. It adds a "Dig" option to Rest Sites, which allows the player to receive a random Relic that is Common, Uncommon, or Rare. The random relic can't be a Shop, Boss, or Event relic.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.

relics.name: Singing Bowl
relics.text: When adding cards to your deck, you may raise your Max HP by 2 instead.
relics.effect: Singing Bowl is an Uncommon Relic. In addition to the usual Skip button when presented with a card reward, a second button +2 Max HP is presented. The player is technically able to Skip the card reward normally without triggering Singing Bowl's Max HP bonus, although the reasons for doing so are niche.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.

relics.name: Smiling Mask
relics.text: The merchant's card removal service now always costs 50 Gold.
relics.effect: Smiling Mask is a Common Relic.
relics.notes:
Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.
Cannot be offered by the Merchant.

relics.name: Spirit Poop
relics.text: It's unpleasant.
relics.effect: Spirit Poop is an Event Relic. It has no effect during the player's run and mostly exists as a joke. It grants the player a -1 score penalty at the end of their run from an effect called "Poopy".
relics.notes: Source: Bonfire Spirits

relics.name: Ssserpent Head
relics.text: Whenever you enter a ? room, gain 50 Gold.
relics.effect: Ssserpent Head is an Event Relic.
relics.notes: Source: Face Trader

relics.name: Strawberry
relics.text: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 7.
relics.effect: Strawberry is a Common Relic.

relics.name: The Courier
relics.text: The Merchant restocks cards, relics, and potions. All prices are reduced by 20%.
relics.effect: The Courier is an Uncommon Relic. When a Card, Relic, or potion is purchased from the Merchant, it will immediately be replaced by another item of the same type.
relics.notes:
Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.
Cannot be offered by the Merchant.

relics.name: Tiny Chest
relics.text: Every 4th ? room is a Treasure room.
relics.effect: Tiny Chest is a Common Relic.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 36.

relics.name: Tiny House
relics.text:
Upon pickup, obtain 1 Potion.
Gain 50 Gold.
Raise your Max HP by 5.
Obtain 1 card.
Upgrade 1 random card.
relics.effect: Tiny House is a Boss Relic. The "obtain 1 card" effect acts as a normal card reward and will show the player 3 cards of which they can choose 1 to permanently add to their deck.

relics.name: Toxic Egg
relics.text: Whenever you add a Skill card to your deck, Upgrade it.
relics.effect: Toxic Egg is an Uncommon Relic.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 49.

relics.name: Toy Ornithopter
relics.text: Whenever you use a potion, heal 5 HP.
relics.effect: Toy Ornithopter is a Common Relic. It heals 5 HP whenever a potion is used. Discarding a potion will not grant the heal.

relics.name: War Paint
relics.text: Upon pick up, Upgrade 2 random Skills.
relics.effect: War Paint is a Common Relic.

relics.name: Whetstone
relics.text: Upon pickup, Upgrade 2 random Attacks.
relics.effect: Whetstone is a Common Relic.
relics.notes: Requirements: Cannot be obtained from Calling Bell or "Obtain Relic" event choices.

relics.name: White Beast Statue
relics.text: Potions always appear in combat rewards.
relics.effect: White Beast Statue is an Uncommon Relic. The extra potion will be awarded during the combat rewards screen as normal.

relics.name: Wing Boots
relics.text: You may ignore paths when choosing the next room to travel to 3 times.
relics.effect: Wing Boots is a Rare Relic. It allows the player to select any room on the next floor when picking a Map Location, regardless of whether it's connected to the player's current Map Location or not. This can be done a maximum of 3 times before the relic becomes unusable.
relics.notes: Requirements: Can only be obtained below floor 41.
